rows.grounds: verb of speaking; speaker asserts the teaching
first member indicating number in the compound
second member referring to the four human goals
purpose or goal of the declared teaching

items.question: Can the declared teaching secure attainment of the four aims without doubt?
premises: The speaker explicitly declares the teaching.
No doubt is said to remain.
The teaching is directed toward attaining the four aims.
items.inference: Therefore the declared teaching is presented as a certain means for attaining the four aims.
uncertainties: The specific four aims are implied by catur-varga but not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: I declare it: there is no doubt, and it is even for the attainment of the four aims.
